teaches: `subType: "augment"` is what makes an equipment Item an augment; the four other sub-types are ordinary gear.
`augment.modifiers[]` raises a characteristic, and `augment.protection` adds to Protection.
`augment.skill {name, value}` is the system's only modifier scoped to one skill.
demo.trap: `augment.skill.name` matches a skill Item by name, exactly as an armour's `requireSkill` does. It reads `Demo — Gun Combat`, which matches the Item named `Demo — Gun Combat (slug)`; a bare `Gun Combat` here would match nothing.

system.description: Nerve lace along the shooting arm. It steadies the hand it was fitted for and no other.
